Are you someone who wants to directly impact the speed at which AWS deploys new capacity for our customers? The Central Operations Install team is looking for someone who enjoys deep diving technical issues, can articulate and document technical solutions, and someone who can work backwards from our customers. What you will own: This role will be a Subject Matter Expert (SME) role working with engineering and service teams across multiple organizations to support the on-boarding of new data center capacity. This role will support the landing of new scaling capacity with a focus on driving increased available customer capacity through defect identification and mitigation. This role will work with new ML/server/network hardware types. This role will contribute to business north star goals, and own input goals at the team level. Who we are: The Central Ops Install team. We are a team that provides technical support to the global operations business within AWS data centers. Our vision is to ensure that work driven into AWS Data Centers is safe, secure, serviceable, supportable and highly available for customers. Who you’ll work with: As an advocate and SME for Data Center Community (DCC) operations team, you will primarily be working within the DCC organization. Aside from your direct team, your daily work engagements will be with the network engineering, service teams, and local operations teams. Why it matters: Amazon and Amazon Web Services are growing at an incredible rate. Now more than ever, AWS needs to innovate with new processes and automation that simplify our operations and execute at massive scale. You will have a company-wide impact; your work will impact thousands of customers. You’ll help us land hardware and quickly deliver customer capacity, in order to enable rapid growth and availability. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting capacity delivery — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Key job responsibilities You will develop solutions to to recover capacity for customers. You will interact directly with Data center technicians to support escalations for issue resolution. You will work with systems engineers to push upstream fixes to enable capacity recovery. You will work to deep dive defects throughout the capacity installation process, and work to develop solutions to mitigate defects. You will contribute to data analytics to support your role. You will evaluate data and trending patterns to uncover defects across product life cycles. A day in the life A day in the life of this role will involve a mix of working with our internal DCC Ops, Support/System Engineering, TPM's, Hardware Engineering, and Software teams to address systemic issues and resolve capacity recovery campaigns. Basic Qualifications 2+ years of software development, or 2+ years of technical support experience Experience scripting in modern program languages Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems Preferred Qualifications Knowledge of web services, distributed systems, and web application development Experience troubleshooting & maintaining hardware & software RAID Experience with REST web services, XML, JSON Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Support the preparation of schedules that balance operational requirements with workforce availability, leave plans, training schedules, and business priorities. Coordinate with maintenance and operations teams to align workforce schedules with preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, inspections, and projects. Ensure compliance with working time regulations, company policies, and operational requirements. Rostering Management Prepare, maintain, and update workforce rosters to ensure adequate operational coverage while considering leave, sickness, training, and other workforce requirements. Monitor roster compliance and adjust schedules to accommodate operational disruptions, emergency requirements, or staffing shortages. Support the implementation of automated rostering solutions and identify opportunities for process improvements to enhance scheduling efficiency and accuracy. Maintain accurate and auditable records of roster changes, approvals, and schedule updates. Resource Planning & Optimization Monitor workforce utilization and identify capacity constraints, resource gaps, and operational inefficiencies. Analyze workforce utilization trends and support the development of recommendations to optimize resource deployment and operational efficiency. Support budget monitoring activities by providing workforce planning, scheduling, and resource utilization reports. Contribute to cost optimization initiatives through effective workforce planning and resource allocation. Material Planning & Coordination Monitor material requirements based on maintenance schedules, projects, and operational activities. Coordinate with Procurement and Stores teams to ensure timely availability of spare parts, consumables, and maintenance materials. Align material availability with maintenance plans to minimize operational delays. Monitor material consumption against planned usage and report shortages, variances, or inefficiencies. Overtime Monitoring & Workforce Analysis Monitor overtime utilization across departments and identify trends and improvement opportunities. Prepare periodic reports highlighting overtime drivers, operational impacts, and cost implications. Support departments by providing workforce planning analysis and overtime-related data. Incorporate overtime performance into operational dashboards and management reports. Data Analysis & Dashboard Management Maintain and update operational dashboards providing visibility of scheduling performance, workforce utilization, overtime, material availability, and operational costs. Ensure reporting dashboards are accurate, user-friendly, and aligned with management reporting requirements. Coordinate with IT and relevant stakeholders to integrate scheduling and reporting systems with CMMS platforms and other business applications. Analyze operational data and generate reports to support informed decision-making. Work Order Management Support the timely and accurate closure of work orders within IBM Maximo by ensuring complete maintenance documentation. Ensure compliance with CMMS documentation standards, audit requirements, and reporting procedures. Support maintenance teams in following standardized work order documentation practices. Project Planning & Coordination Monitor project schedules, milestones, resource allocation, and material requirements. Track project resource utilization and budget performance throughout execution. Prepare project progress reports highlighting risks, delays, resource constraints, and corrective actions. Cross-Functional Coordination Collaborate with Operations, Engineering, HR, Procurement, Finance, Safety, and Logistics teams to ensure alignment of planning and scheduling activities. Coordinate workforce and resource planning to support maintenance, operational priorities, and special projects. Support planning for major maintenance activities, public holidays, shutdowns, and special operational events. Prepare planning reports and resource analyses to support management decision-making. Continuous Improvement & Compliance Monitor and report KPIs related to scheduling efficiency, workforce utilization, overtime management, material planning, and work order performance. Support the implementation of digital tools and system enhancements to improve planning efficiency. Ensure planning, scheduling, and work management activities comply with safety, quality, regulatory, and company requirements. Safety Responsibilities Promote a positive safety culture within the workplace and attend any safety-related meetings or briefings as required within the job role. Comply with the requirements of RDMC RQHSE Policy and Safety Management System. Be mindful that Safety, Security, and Environmental protection are everyone’s responsibility. Knowledge Proficiency in Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), preferably IBM Maximo. Good understanding of maintenance planning, scheduling, resource management, and workforce coordination principles. Strong knowledge of work order management processes. Experience in KPI monitoring, performance measurement, and operational reporting. Strong analytical and data interpretation skills. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel. Good understanding of workforce planning, rostering, and overtime management. Familiarity with reporting tools, dashboards, and data visualization techniques. Strong organizational, planning, and coordination skills. Experience 0–3 years of experience in scheduling, planning, project coordination, or resource management will also be considered. experience in maintenance planning, scheduling, workforce planning, or resource coordination. Experience within a railway, transportation, industrial, or asset-intensive maintenance environment is preferred. Experience using IBM Maximo or similar CMMS platforms is preferred. Exposure to change management initiatives and continuous improvement practices is an advantage. Desired Behaviors & Experiences Safety-First Commitment: Demonstrates commitment to safety by following procedures and supporting compliance with safety, quality, and regulatory requirements. Planning and Organizational Skills: Effectively plans, prioritizes, and coordinates daily scheduling and resource planning activities. Attention to Detail: Maintains a high level of accuracy in schedules, reports, work orders, and operational records. Communication and Teamwork: Collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams and communicates clearly with internal stakeholders. Coordination Skills: Coordinates planning and scheduling activities to support operational requirements and business priorities. Customer and Operational Support Orientation: Delivers responsive support to internal stakeholders while maintaining service quality. Accountability and Ownership: Takes responsibility for assigned activities, meets commitments, and follows through on deliverables. Continuous Improvement Mindset: Identifies opportunities for process improvements and supports the implementation of planning and scheduling enhancements. Adaptability: Responds effectively to changing operational priorities and works efficiently in dynamic environments. Time Management: Manages multiple priorities and consistently meets deadlines.
